gui.fredplenter.faq_get_note: How do I get a note?
gui.fredplenter.faq_get_note_desc: Open the Codex, choose available research, and press Begin. Paper research needs paper and ink in an inkwell. Place the created note in the table slot.
gui.fredplenter.faq_solve: How do I solve the puzzle?
gui.fredplenter.faq_solve_desc: Click the start cell. Select a discovered aspect on the left and click an empty neighboring cell. Each tile must neighbor the previous tile and link to its aspect by recipe. Every aspect may appear only once. Pass through the required middle aspect, then click the end cell. The shortest geometric route has 5 cells total; some research needs a longer route to follow valid aspect links without repeats. Points are only spent on success: one point per placed tile.
gui.fredplenter.faq_example_desc: For Flatus → Procella → Unda, place Procella in a neighboring cell between the start and end. Procella links to both aspects. The placed tile costs 1 Procella point.
gui.fredplenter.faq_combine: How do I create compound aspects?
gui.fredplenter.faq_combine_desc: Select a recipe in the bottom panel and press Create to make 1 result point. To make the maximum allowed by component balances and free result capacity, hold Shift and press Create to arm the confirmation, release Shift, then press Confirm maximum. Selecting a recipe never consumes points. For example, Flamma + Unda = Vapor: 1 point of each component is spent. To create a result for the first time, discover both components; the result unlocks automatically.
gui.fredplenter.faq_discover: How do I discover more aspects?
gui.fredplenter.faq_discover_desc: Study items with the Aura Scanner or Wand to discover aspects. Hover over a compound aspect in the left panel to see its recipe. Interface text and this guide follow the language selected in Minecraft settings.
